2018–2022 · Technology, design & discovery

Pathways Academy of Technology and Design

I chose Pathways for its technology focus. My high school years brought new creative tools, online discoveries, good teachers, difficult experiences, and the disruption of COVID.

Why Pathways

I attended Pathways Academy of Technology and Design from 2018 to 2022. The technology offerings were the reason I chose the school: I wanted to explore the tools and subjects that interested me.

Alongside the technology classes, there were English classes and the rest of high school. I met nice people and learned from some great teachers. All of that is part of the story.

Tech Rotation

In my first year, the “Tech Rotation” introduced me to different areas of technology and creative work. The subjects included:

Video Game Design

An early opportunity to explore making games using the software "Alice".

Digital Video & Media

Working with video tools like Premiere Cut Pro to create visual media.

Digital Music

Creating various music through GarageBand.

3D Modeling

An introduction to 3D modeling (Computer-Aided Design) tools such as Tinkercad.

Web Design

An early encounter with building for the web, using HTML, and an introduction to the internet.

Discovering a Much Bigger Online World

During these years, I spent much more time online and found a wide range of tools, platforms, communities, and things to explore. This is when I found Quora, in November of 2018, early in my time at Pathways.

That online exploration became another part of my learning, alongside what I was doing in school.
